meta.title: MindFlow — AI mood journal for students & young professionals
meta.description: MindFlow is an Android app that helps students and young professionals catch stress patterns early through AI-assisted journaling, stress-adaptive habits, and emotional analytics.

hero.headingBefore: Reduce stress blind spots by up to
hero.description: MindFlow turns your daily journaling into actionable emotional intelligence, right from your phone — so you catch burnout signals before they become a bigger problem.
hero.stat1Label: faster pattern detection vs. manual journaling
hero.stat2Label: daily check-in to stay on track

problem.title: You can't fix what you can't see
problem.description: Students and young professionals face chronic stress — but most only notice it once it's already overwhelming.
problem.item1Text: Mood swings and fatigue pile up for weeks before you connect the dots.
problem.item2Text: One-size-fits-all meditations don't match your actual triggers or schedule.
problem.item3Text: A therapist needs structured history — not scattered notes on your phone.

howItWorks.title: Three steps to emotional clarity
howItWorks.description: From a 2-minute daily log to insights you can act on — or share with your psychologist.
howItWorks.step1Text: Write freely or pick a mood. AI automatically tags themes like exams, sleep, or relationships.
howItWorks.step2Text: See weekly trends, stress triggers, and habit correlations in clear dashboards.
howItWorks.step3Text: Get breathing guides when stress spikes. Export PDF/CSV reports for clinical sessions (Premium).

differentiation.title: Built for depth — not another generic diary
differentiation.description: This is what sets us apart from standard mood trackers and meditation apps.
differentiation.item1Text: Understands the context in your entries, not just a random emoji pick.
differentiation.item2Text: Goals adjust when your stress level rises, so you don't burn out chasing streaks.
differentiation.item3Text: Structured PDF histories and raw CSV for your therapist or your own analysis.
differentiation.item4Text: Breathing and meditation guides triggered by your real patterns — not random notifications.

features.title: Everything you need for emotional clarity
features.subtitle: Tools designed for busy students and professionals.
features.f1Text: Interactive diary with NLP that surfaces themes and sentiment.
features.f2Text: Goals that adapt when stress increases — no guilt-driven streaks.
features.f3Text: Breathing and meditation guides right when you need them.
features.f4Text: Mood calendar and word cloud to spot patterns at a glance.

analytics.title: Turn emotions into decisions
analytics.description: Weekly mood trends and trigger maps so you optimize rest, study, and work — not guess.

nosotros.title: We are CogniTech
nosotros.description: A student startup at the intersection of mental health and artificial intelligence, built by Software Engineering students at UPC.
nosotros.missionText: To empower people to manage their emotional wellbeing through intelligent, accessible, and ethical applications that make it easier to build healthy habits and self-awareness.
nosotros.visionText: To be the region's leading startup in building digital mental-health ecosystems, transforming how technology assists people in their personal growth and emotional balance.
nosotros.teamDescription: Five Software Engineering students at UPC, split across backend, the mobile app, the landing page, and quality.
nosotros.member1Bio: Software Engineering student interested in web development, interface design, and user experience. Co-leads the Android mobile app and the project's deployment setup.
nosotros.member2Bio: Codes in C++, C#, JavaScript, and Python, with an interest in solutions for business processes. Co-leads the backend across all 8 bounded contexts and heads up the product landing page.
nosotros.member3Bio: Codes in C++, C#, and Python, plus web development with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Leads the team's style guidelines and co-leads the backend, focused on IAM, Journal, AI Assistant, and Habits.
nosotros.member4Bio: Builds with Angular, Vue.js, Node.js, and Python, with experience deploying on Docker, GCP, and Azure. Co-leads the Android mobile app and the project's deployment setup.
nosotros.member5Bio: Codes in C++ and web development, with an interest in advanced algorithms and data structures. Leads prototyping, testing, and the team's Sprint Review evidence.
nosotros.ctaText: Discover how MindFlow turns daily journaling into emotional clarity.

terms.title: Terms and Conditions
terms.s1Text: By accessing or using MindFlow (the "App"), developed by the CogniTech team as an academic project at UPC, you agree to these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree, do not use the App. MindFlow is a self-care and reflection tool: it does not replace care from a psychologist, psychiatrist, or other health professional, and the AI assistant does not give diagnoses or treatments. If you feel you are at risk or might harm yourself, seek help immediately: Line 113, option 5 (mental health, Peru's Ministry of Health) or 106 (SAMU).
terms.s2Text: You must be 18 years or older and have the legal capacity to accept these terms. You can sign up with your email and password or with your Google account. You are responsible for keeping your login credentials secure and for all activity under your account; the information you provide when registering must be accurate. You can delete your account from the app: this removes your journal, habits, and AI conversations, though some payment or support records may be kept for legal or accounting obligations.
terms.s3Text: You may use MindFlow for lawful personal purposes only. You must not attempt unauthorized access to other users' data, compromise the App's security, or use the AI assistant to obtain content that promotes harm to yourself or others. AI-generated insights (via the Google Gemini API) are informational, may contain errors, and are not a clinical diagnosis.
terms.s4Text: Freemium is free, with the basic journal, habit, and assistant features. Premium costs USD 4.99 per month (plus taxes depending on your country), is charged through Stripe — MindFlow does not store your card details — and renews every month until you cancel by writing to cognitech.mindflow@gmail.com; the subscription stays active until the end of the period already paid. Periods already started are not refunded, except where the law requires it or the charge was our mistake.
terms.s5Text: The content of your journal entries and your conversations with the assistant is stored encrypted with AES-256. We do not sell your data or use it for advertising, and we do not use the content of your entries or conversations to train our own or third-party models. Export features are provided for your personal use and for sharing with professionals you choose; you are responsible for how you share exported data. See our Privacy Policy for more detail.
terms.s6Text: MindFlow is provided "as is": it is developed in an academic context and may have interruptions, errors, or changes. We do not guarantee that it will always be available or that AI responses will be accurate or suitable for your situation. To the extent permitted by law, we are not liable for indirect damages arising from use of the App or for decisions you make based on AI responses. Nothing here limits the rights the law gives you as a consumer (Law No. 29571, Consumer Protection and Defense Code).
terms.s7Text: We may update these Terms. If the change is significant, we will notify you in the app or on the site before it takes effect; continued use afterward means you accept the change. For questions: cognitech.mindflow@gmail.com.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.s1Text: Account data (name, email, and password stored in a protected form, or your basic Google account details); content you create (journal entries, mood, tags, attachments, habits and their completion, and your messages to the AI assistant); summaries calculated from your own entries; and your subscription and payment data (your plan and its status — your card details are processed by Stripe, MindFlow does not store them).
privacy.s2Text: We use your data to provide the service: store your journal and habits, generate AI answers and insights (via the Google Gemini API), show your analytics, process your subscription, and send necessary emails (for example, password recovery). We do not sell your data or use it for advertising, and we do not train our own models with your content; the AI provider processes it under its own terms.
privacy.s3Text: The content of your journal entries and of your conversations with the assistant is stored encrypted with AES-256. Communication between the app and our servers uses secure connections. We process your data in accordance with Peru's Personal Data Protection Law (Law No. 29733) and its regulations. Even so, no system is completely invulnerable and we cannot guarantee absolute security.
privacy.s4Text: You can access your data, rectify it, cancel (delete) it, and object to its processing by writing to cognitech.mindflow@gmail.com. Deleting your account removes your journal, habits, and conversations; some payment or support records may be kept for legal or accounting obligations. If you believe we have not handled your request properly, you may contact Peru's National Authority for Personal Data Protection.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.s1Text: Cookies are small text files stored on your device. MindFlow's website may use essential cookies for language preference and basic session functionality.
cookies.s2Text: Essential: mindflow-locale (stores your ES/EN preference). Analytics (optional): anonymized visit statistics if enabled. We do not use cookies to read your journal content.
cookies.s3Text: You can clear cookies in your browser settings. Disabling essential cookies may reset your language preference on the landing page.
